danas_saveti.razlog_sr: Intenzivan napor produbljuje udah — proceni simptome.
Vlaga je 90 % — veš se teško suši napolju.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Connectorovo razdvajanje: trenutni maksimumi čestica dele Zeleno brdo, ali zajednička stanica ne dokazuje zajednički uzrok. Ne mogu da pretvorim Observerov nepromenjeni maksimum azot-dioksida u dokaz nepromenjenih uslova drugde: veza prati maksimum, a ne putanju svake stanice. [F4][F8][F6][F7]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Connector’s separation: the current particulate maxima share Zeleno brdo, but sharing a station does not establish a shared cause [F4][F8]. I cannot turn Observer’s unchanged nitrogen dioxide maximum into evidence of unchanged conditions elsewhere: the connection tracks the maximum, not every station’s trajectory [F6][F7].
